create_profiler_context: create a torch.autograd.profiler.profile context manager to benchmark PyTorch operations with CPU and CUDA timing
run_profile_with_memory: run torch.autograd.profiler.profile with profile_memory and with_stack enabled to analyze memory allocations and source code locations
summarize_profile_results: summarize torch.autograd.profiler.profile results using key_averages and table to sort operations by self_cpu_time_total
label_code_block: label a code block with torch.autograd.profiler.record_function to categorize operations in profiler output
export_chrome_trace: export torch.autograd.profiler.profile results to a Chrome trace JSON file for visualization in Chrome DevTools
